authorization: 3D YANIMDA İÇİN LİSTEDEKİ TÜM EKSİKLERİ VE DÜZENLENİP GELİŞTİRİLMESİ GEREKEN TÜM HER ŞEY İÇİN EKSİKSİZ PLAN ÇIKAR VE TAMAMLA
review: All 13 guide append patches, 5 complete new pages, 103 route-specific metadata descriptions and 21 diagram compositions reviewed against source, intent and existing service scope.
Publication dates are preserved on existing records; absent first-publication dates remain absent. Four genuinely new guides have the current initial publication timestamp.
New media are explanatory technical diagrams, not customer-project photography. No prices, certifications, tolerances, workshop assets or case-study outcomes invented.
All four brands' content originality was checked at current source; 805 raw records, zero findings. Earlier visually similar figures were redrawn, not exempted.

274 Vitest tests passed across 49 files; 74 search/export/release contract tests and 3 CSS selection tests passed. TypeScript, production Vite compilation, protocol integrity and evidence checks passed.

ContentHub now receives validated CMS media dimensions through the small summary projection and renders only known intrinsic dimensions. Five tests cover actual sizes, unknown omission, projection and full-record authority.
CMS publication plan uses strict expected baseline hashes and a single transaction, preserving both review triggers and validating exact readback; other tenants are fingerprinted before and after.
Historical broad all-brand/theme evidence remains historical. Shared-code changes receive current unit/DOM coverage; existing CI performs real browser/export verification before merge.

CI surfaced historical fixed solution-count and brand-card-only expectations. Reviewed regression updates now compare the exact tenant-scoped published solution inventory and exact SEO override/page/home/fallback image precedence, while retaining MIME, raster dimension, Twitter/Article parity and cross-tenant rejection checks. Nine new social image contract fixtures pass; current browser/export runs must pass before merge.
limitations: Local supervised browser preview could not start because the preview runner could not resolve the available Vite dependency symlink. No alternative browser was installed; fresh full-browser/export checks are required in the existing CI before merge.
This review is source/content approval, not a claim that a deployment or Google indexing has already happened.
GSC/GA4 account data, GBP ownership, actual WAF crawler logs and post-release 28-day comparison are not established by source tests.
Actual opening hours, coordinates, official social profiles, named expert identity, historical first publication dates and real case-study/photographic evidence require verified business inputs.
